decisions.why: Intraocular lenses including FINEVISION HP TORIC and FINEVISION variants are implantable lenses for cataract surgery (ophthalmology:iol).
Monofocal intraocular lenses including ANKORIS, MICROPURE, PODEYE TORIC, PODEYE are standard IOL products (ophthalmology:iol).
Phacoemulsification machines (R-Evo Smart E/S, R-Evolution) are capital equipment for cataract surgery (ophthalmology:equip).
Ophthalmic surgical dyes including MONOBLUE DUAL View and MONOBLUE SafR are consumables for vitreoretinal surgery (ophthalmology:cons).
Combined phacoemulsification/vitrectomy systems (R-Evolution CR, R-Evo Smart CR) are capital equipment (ophthalmology:equip).
Ophthalmic Viscosurgical Devices including HPMC Hypromellose and NuVisc PRO are surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Cryoprobe for retinal detachment repair is a surgical instrument/consumable (ophthalmology:cons).
MONOBLUE ILM View is an ophthalmic dye for vitreoretinal surgery consumable (ophthalmology:cons).
Punctal occlusion devices are ophthalmic surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Ophthalmic microsurgical instruments are consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
ISOPURE is a premium monofocal intraocular lens (ophthalmology:iol).
ARCEOLE is an intraocular gas used for retinal tamponade in vitreoretinal surgery (ophthalmology:cons).
ARCALINE/ARCOTANE are perfluorocarbon liquids for retinal tamponade, ophthalmic surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
ARCIOLANE 1300/5500 are silicone oils for retinal tamponade in vitreoretinal surgery (ophthalmology:cons).
90° Directional Laser Probes are ophthalmic surgical instruments for laser procedures (ophthalmology:cons).
Ophthalmic surgical instruments used in vitreoretinal procedures (ophthalmology:cons).
Ophthalmic tissue manipulation instruments are surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Backflush instruments for ophthalmic surgery are surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Disposable Vitrectomy Lenses are consumables for vitreoretinal surgery (ophthalmology:cons).
Ophthalmic light fiber instruments are surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
29G Spotlight Directional Chandelier is a vitreoretinal illumination instrument (ophthalmology:cons).
Ophthalmic single-use surgical instruments are consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Endo Optiks endocyclophotocoagulation system is an ophthalmic surgical instrument (ophthalmology:cons).
Fluid management instruments for ophthalmic surgery are surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Electrosurgery tools for ophthalmic procedures are surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Sterile irrigating solutions for ophthalmic surgery are consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
OP'COVER corneal protective device is an ophthalmic surgical consumable (ophthalmology:cons).
Beaver surgical knives for ophthalmic procedures are surgical consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Surgical drapes for ophthalmic procedures are theatre consumables (ophthalmology:cons).
Ophthalmic cannulas are surgical instruments (ophthalmology:cons).
